SELECT a.id, a.title, a.introduce, a.time, a.location, a.intcircle_id AS intcircleId, a.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS hostNickname, u.avatar AS hostAvatar FROM sys_activity a JOIN sys_user u ON a.create_user = u.id
intcircle_id=#{intcircleId}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.introduce, a.time, a.location, a.intcircle_id AS intcircleId, a.create_time AS createTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_activity ua2 WHERE ua2.activity_id = a.id) AS total, hu.nickname AS hostNickname, hu.avatar AS hostAvatar, su.id AS signupUserId, su.nickname AS signupUserNickname, su.avatar AS signupUserAvatar, su.phone AS signupUserPhone FROM sys_activity a JOIN sys_user hu ON a.create_user = hu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user_activity ua ON a.id = ua.activity_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = ua.user_id WHERE a.id = #{id} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.introduce, a.time, a.location, a.intcircle_id AS intcircleId, a.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS hostNickname, u.avatar AS hostAvatar FROM sys_activity a JOIN sys_user u ON a.create_user = u.id WHERE a.create_user = #{userId}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.introduce, a.time, a.location, a.intcircle_id AS intcircleId, a.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS hostNickname, u.avatar AS hostAvatar FROM sys_activity a JOIN sys_user u ON a.create_user = u.id JOIN sys_user_activity ua WHERE ua.user_id = #{userId}
